algorithm.canonical_json: json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded utf-8
algorithm.salt: 32 random bytes, hex-encoded to 64 characters, withheld until reveal

hiding: everyone, including the author: the selected reports do not exist yet
payload_location: n/a, the payload is this rule and it is published in full

public_rule.description: Eval-suite defect reports that did not exist when this seal was made.
public_rule.if_fewer_than_5_at_reveal: Reveal what the rule selected, report N explicitly, and state that the transfer diagnostic is underpowered at that N rather than extending the window to reach a rounder number.
predicate: filed strictly after the cutoff_utc below
concerns a DETERMINISTIC scorer, matcher, normalizer, threshold, aggregation or fixture
NOT an LLM-judge or rubric defect
the report or its fix identifies a concrete wrong verdict: a correct output scored wrong, or an incorrect output scored right
closed or merged, so the maintainers agreed it was a defect
public_rule.selection: The first 5 reports satisfying the predicate, ordered by creation timestamp ascending. Ties broken by ascending issue/PR number. No discretion is exercised at reveal: the ordering is total and the count is fixed here.

revision_boundary: commits reachable from HEAD but not from sealed_at_commit touching evalmut/operators.py, evalmut/operator.py, evalmut/case.py, demos/, external/
rotation: On reveal the 5 become development operators; instance 002 is sealed BEFORE any of them is implemented.
